targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM subagents WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)), 0), 4) as "Total Cost"
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_usd), 4) as "Subagent Cost" FROM subagents WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Sessions" FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Commands" FROM turns WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 4) as "Avg Cost" FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)

SELECT d as "Date", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN src='session' THEN cost ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) as "Sessions", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN src='subagent' THEN cost ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) as "Subagents" FROM (SELECT date(started_at) as d, cost_usd as cost, 'session' as src FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) UNION ALL SELECT date(started_at), cost_usd, 'subagent' FROM subagents WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY d ORDER BY d ASC

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-4%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Opus 4", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-6%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Sonnet 4.6", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-5%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Sonnet 4.5", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-4%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Haiku 4", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-3%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Opus 3", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-3%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Sonnet 3", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-3%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END),4) as "Haiku 3" FROM (SELECT model, cost_usd FROM turns WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) AND model NOT LIKE '<%' UNION ALL SELECT model, cost_usd FROM subagent_turns WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) AND model NOT LIKE '<%')

SELECT project as "Project", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN src='session' THEN cost ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Sessions", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN src='subagent' THEN cost ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Subagents" FROM (SELECT project, cost_usd as cost, 'session' as src FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) UNION ALL SELECT project, cost_usd, 'subagent' FROM subagents WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER)) GROUP BY project ORDER BY SUM(cost) DESC

SELECT date(started_at) as "Date", SUM(input_tokens) as "Input", SUM(output_tokens) as "Output", SUM(cache_read_tokens) as "Cache Read" FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY date(started_at) ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', started_at) as "Started", name as "Session", project as "Project", CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-4%' THEN 'Opus 4' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-6%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.6' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-5%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.5' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4%' THEN 'Sonnet 4' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-4%' THEN 'Haiku 4' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-3%' THEN 'Opus 3' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-3%' THEN 'Sonnet 3' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-3%' THEN 'Haiku 3' ELSE model END as "Model", turns as "Turns", printf('%d:%02d', duration_s/60, duration_s%60) as "Duration", input_tokens as "Input", output_tokens as "Output", cache_read_tokens as "Cache Read", cache_creation_tokens as "Cache Write", ROUND(cost_usd, 4) as "Cost USD" FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY started_at DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', t.timestamp) as "Time", t.turn_index + 1 as "#", s.name as "Session", t.project as "Project", CASE WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-opus-4%' THEN 'Opus 4' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-6%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.6' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-5%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.5' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4%' THEN 'Sonnet 4' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-haiku-4%' THEN 'Haiku 4' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-opus-3%' THEN 'Opus 3' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-3%' THEN 'Sonnet 3' WHEN t.model LIKE 'claude-haiku-3%' THEN 'Haiku 3' ELSE t.model END as "Model", t.input_tokens as "Input", t.output_tokens as "Output", t.cache_read_tokens as "Cache Read", t.cache_write_tokens as "Cache Write", ROUND(t.cost_usd, 5) as "Cost USD" FROM turns t LEFT JOIN sessions s ON t.session_id = s.id WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', t.timestamp) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) AND t.model NOT LIKE '<%' ORDER BY t.timestamp DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT SUBSTR(name, 1, 55) as "Session", ROUND(cost_usd, 4) as "Cost USD" FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN cost_usd < 0.001 THEN '< $0.001' WHEN cost_usd < 0.01 THEN '$0.001-0.01' WHEN cost_usd < 0.05 THEN '$0.01-0.05' WHEN cost_usd < 0.10 THEN '$0.05-0.10' ELSE '> $0.10' END as "Cost Range", COUNT(*) as "Commands" FROM turns WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) AND model NOT LIKE '<%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(cost_usd)

panels.title: Tokens per Turn — Avg by Model

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-4%' THEN 'Opus 4' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-6%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.6' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-5%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.5' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4%' THEN 'Sonnet 4' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-4%' THEN 'Haiku 4' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-3%' THEN 'Opus 3' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-3%' THEN 'Sonnet 3' WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-3%' THEN 'Haiku 3' ELSE model END as "Model", ROUND(AVG(input_tokens)) as "Avg Input", ROUND(AVG(output_tokens)) as "Avg Output" FROM turns WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) AND model NOT LIKE '<%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT SUBSTR(name, 1, 40) as "Session", input_tokens as "Input", cache_read_tokens as "Cache Read", cache_creation_tokens as "Cache Write" FROM sessions WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) AND (cache_read_tokens > 0 OR cache_creation_tokens > 0) ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(agent_type,''), 'unknown') as "Type", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-4%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Opus 4", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-6%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Sonnet 4.6", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-5%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Sonnet 4.5", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-4%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Haiku 4", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-opus-3%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Opus 3", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-3%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Sonnet 3", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN model LIKE 'claude-haiku-3%' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 4) as "Haiku 3" FROM subagents WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(cost_usd) DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTR(description,1,50),''), id) as "Subagent", ROUND(cost_usd, 4) as "Cost USD" FROM subagents WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', a.started_at) as "Started", COALESCE(NULLIF(a.agent_type,''), 'agent') as "Type", a.description as "Description", a.project as "Project", CASE WHEN a.model LIKE 'claude-opus-4%' THEN 'Opus 4' WHEN a.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-6%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.6' WHEN a.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4-5%' THEN 'Sonnet 4.5' WHEN a.model LIKE 'claude-sonnet-4%' THEN 'Sonnet 4' WHEN a.model LIKE 'claude-haiku-4%' THEN 'Haiku 4' ELSE a.model END as "Model", a.turns as "Turns", a.input_tokens as "Input", a.output_tokens as "Output", a.cache_read_tokens as "Cache Read", ROUND(a.cost_usd, 4) as "Cost USD", SUBSTR(s.name, 1, 60) as "Parent Session" FROM subagents a LEFT JOIN sessions s ON a.session_id = s.id WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', a.started_at) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now', '-$days days') AS INTEGER) ORDER BY a.started_at DESC
